dl_methodology: Aggregates TVL in all Peapods Finance indexes created

tvl_decomposition.note: DL splits each chain into tvl (token sitting in vaults), staking (LP staked in StakingPoolToken), and borrowed (Fraxlend pair borrows). The 'borrowed' bucket is double-counted relative to tvl since borrowed assets started in a pool. Total reported on DL is the union.

lifecycle_evidence.event: First peak at $30.5M after Arbitrum/Base/Mode launches
Latest team deployer contract creation on Ethereum (StakingVault)
Current TVL $2.0M = 5.4% of peak; protocol still operating

tier: Tier 2 — mid-TVL active protocol with permissionless factory
